title: Choose the reference runner's sandbox boundary and where holdout expectations live
goal: Choose the reference runner's sandbox boundary and where holdout expectations live
acceptance: The owner picks the isolation boundary for model-written code (container, macOS sandbox profile, Linux namespaces) and accepts its local requirement
The owner picks whether holdout expectations stay public (contamination-exposed) or move to a private store
The choices and date are recorded in the record
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Owner answer recorded in the record
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 in the domain-packs plan (owner request); owner time only.
